map_info.title: Cellular Noise
map_info.description: Enter the curved womb membrane on the left, then the connected cells on the right. Missing central partitions make a larger shared room. Beyond the entrances, thin strands trace the edges of a three-dimensional Voronoi diagram, with cords attached directly to existing floors, walls and ceilings where present. Compare a boundary as wall, opening and line. The completed net responds to gravity and cable tension through its shared knots.

learning_objectives: Read feature-point distances as walls and edges
Compare enclosure with a shared clearing
Distinguish cell edges from connections between feature points
